disciplines.name: Animalism
disciplines.summary: Extends the Beast's dominion over animals, familiars, territory, and the feral impulses of living beings.

levels.name: Feral Whispers
levels.summary: Communicate with animals and issue simple commands.

levels.name: Raise Familiar
levels.summary: Raise a recently dead animal as a loyal undead familiar.

levels.name: Summon the Hunt
levels.summary: Call nearby animals of a chosen kind to the vampire.

levels.name: Feral Infection
levels.summary: Drive people or animals into violent, bestial behavior.

levels.name: Lord of the Land
levels.summary: Claim territory and perceive or influence events through its animals.

disciplines.name: Auspex
disciplines.summary: Heightens perception until the vampire can read auras, objects, minds, and distant places.

levels.name: Beast's Hackles
levels.summary: Ask the Beast a question about immediate danger or weakness.

levels.name: Uncanny Perception
levels.summary: Read revealing details in a subject's aura and behavior.

levels.name: The Spirit's Touch
levels.summary: Read strong impressions and memories attached to an object.

levels.name: Lay Open the Mind
levels.summary: Enter a subject's thoughts and search their memories.

levels.name: Twilight Projection
levels.summary: Project the senses and spirit away from the body.

disciplines.name: Celerity
disciplines.summary: Permanently adds its dots to Defense and Initiative; Vitae can fuel bursts of impossible speed and reflexes.

disciplines.name: Dominate
disciplines.summary: Imposes commands, false memories, and finally possession through the vampire's will.

levels.name: Mesmerize
levels.summary: Place a victim in a receptive trance.

levels.name: Iron Edict
levels.summary: Plant a direct command in a mesmerized victim.

levels.name: Entombed Command
levels.summary: Hide a command behind a later trigger.

levels.name: The Lying Mind
levels.summary: Rewrite or suppress a victim's memories.

levels.name: Possession
levels.summary: Take complete control of another person's body.

disciplines.name: Majesty
disciplines.summary: Turns supernatural presence into fascination, trust, loyalty, and worship.

levels.name: Awe
levels.summary: Draw attention and make social influence easier.

levels.name: Confidant
levels.summary: Create an intimate bond that invites trust and disclosure.

levels.name: Green Eyes
levels.summary: Inspire jealousy and competition for the vampire's favor.

levels.name: Loyalty
levels.summary: Create intense devotion and the Enthralled Condition.

levels.name: Idol
levels.summary: Overwhelm a crowd with adoration and obedience.

disciplines.name: Nightmare
disciplines.summary: Weaponizes the terror inspired by the Beast.

levels.name: Dread Presence
levels.summary: Radiate palpable fear and unease.

levels.name: Face of the Beast
levels.summary: Focus terror on a victim through the predator's gaze.

levels.name: The Grand Delusion
levels.summary: Make a victim believe a convincing personal nightmare.

levels.name: Waking Nightmare
levels.summary: Make a nightmare appear real to the victim's senses.

levels.name: Mortal Terror
levels.summary: Inflict overwhelming terror capable of breaking body and mind.

disciplines.name: Obfuscate
disciplines.summary: Erases the vampire, companions, objects, and places from attention and memory.

levels.name: Face in the Crowd
levels.summary: Fade into a crowd and become unremarkable.

levels.name: Touch of Shadow
levels.summary: Hide an object from notice.

levels.name: Cloak of Night
levels.summary: Vanish from direct observation.

levels.name: The Familiar Stranger
levels.summary: Appear to be the person an observer expects to see.

levels.name: Oubliette
levels.summary: Hide a place and those within it from the outside world.

disciplines.name: Protean
disciplines.summary: Reshapes the vampire through earth, animal adaptations, full forms, and monstrous transformation.

levels.name: Unmarked Grave
levels.summary: Merge with natural earth to rest safely.

levels.name: Predatory Aspect
levels.summary: Manifest three chosen animal adaptations.

levels.name: Beast's Skin
levels.summary: Take stored animal forms.

levels.name: Unnatural Aspect
levels.summary: Manifest a powerful monstrous adaptation.

levels.name: Primeval Miasma
levels.summary: Dissolve into a predatory cloud that can hunt and feed.

disciplines.name: Resilience
disciplines.summary: Permanently adds its dots to Stamina and Health; Vitae can mitigate severe injury.

disciplines.name: Vigor
disciplines.summary: Permanently adds its dots to Strength and Speed; Vitae can fuel overwhelming feats and attacks.

devotions.name: Body of Will
devotions.summary: Suppresses wound penalties and turns fresh injury into fuel for Vigor.

devotions.name: Chain of Command
devotions.summary: Places a Dominate effect in a victim for later use against a designated subject.

devotions.name: Cloak the Gathering
devotions.summary: Extends Obfuscate to a group near the vampire.

devotions.name: Conditioning
devotions.summary: Repeatedly erodes a mesmerized victim's will toward complete enslavement.

devotions.name: Cross-Contamination
devotions.summary: Blends awe and terror into a disorienting emotional aura.

devotions.name: Cult of Personality
devotions.summary: Broadcasts Loyalty across a crowd and enthralls the susceptible.

devotions.name: Enchantment
devotions.summary: Redirects an enthralled victim's devotion to another person, place, or object.

devotions.name: Enfeebling Aura
devotions.summary: Sacrifices Majesty to suppress a victim's physical Disciplines for the scene.

devotions.name: Foul Grave
devotions.summary: Projects predatory aura while resting within an Unmarked Grave.

devotions.name: Force of Nature
devotions.summary: Assumes multiple Protean adaptations and redistributes Physical Attributes for a scene.

devotions.name: Gargoyle's Vigilance
devotions.summary: Grants total vigilance over a haven while the vampire remains still.

devotions.name: Hint of Fear
devotions.summary: Uses Face of the Beast with a rapid, unnoticeable glance.

devotions.name: Juggernaut's Gait
devotions.summary: Briefly renders the vampire immune to all harm.

devotions.name: Quicken Sight
devotions.summary: Perceives fast events in slow motion and applies Defense against ranged attacks for a turn.

devotions.name: Reason's Salon
devotions.summary: Calms predatory auras and supports frenzy resistance within a prepared place.

devotions.name: Riot
devotions.summary: Drives a wide area into destructive, selfish bedlam.

devotions.name: Shared Sight
devotions.summary: Temporarily lends dots of Auspex to another person.

devotions.name: Shatter the Shroud
devotions.summary: Ends a supernatural concealment after winning the Clash of Wills.

devotions.name: Stalwart Servant
devotions.summary: Lends Resilience to a servant who drinks the vampire's Vitae.

devotions.name: Subsume the Lesser Beast
devotions.summary: Projects the vampire's mind into a predatory animal.

devotions.name: Summoning (Dominate)
devotions.summary: Compels a previously mesmerized victim to travel to the vampire.

devotions.name: Summoning (Majesty)
devotions.summary: Compels a previous subject of Awe to travel to the vampire.

devotions.name: Sun's Brutal Dreamscape
devotions.summary: Makes a sleeping Kindred victim share the vampire's sunlight wounds.

devotions.name: Touch of Deprivation
devotions.summary: Temporarily denies a touched victim one sense or known Auspex ability.

devotions.name: Undying Familiar
devotions.summary: Causes a living ghouled animal to rise through Raise Familiar when killed.

devotions.name: Wet Dream
devotions.summary: Afflicts a sleeping victim with intertwined fear and desire.

devotions.name: The Wish
devotions.summary: Temporarily exalts a mortal before binding them in lasting enthrallment.

devotions.name: Vermin Flood
devotions.summary: Calls a destructive swarm of small animals over a prepared area.

devotions.name: Wraith's Presence
devotions.summary: Projects a false image elsewhere when using Cloak of Night.

cruacRites.name: Pangs of Proserpina
cruacRites.summary: Provokes supernatural hunger in a distant victim.

cruacRites.name: Rigor Mortis
cruacRites.summary: Penalizes a vampire victim's next physical action.

cruacRites.name: Cheval
cruacRites.summary: Lets the ritualist see and hear through a touched subject.

cruacRites.name: The Hydra's Vitae
cruacRites.summary: Makes the ritualist's blood poisonous to drink.

cruacRites.name: Deflection of Wooden Doom
cruacRites.summary: Prevents attempts to stake the ritualist until sunrise.

cruacRites.name: Touch of the Morrigan
cruacRites.summary: Turns the ritualist's touch into a lethal curse.

cruacRites.name: Blood Price
cruacRites.summary: Redirects blood consumed by a subject to the ritualist.

cruacRites.name: Willful Vitae
cruacRites.summary: Protects the ritualist from blood bonds and Vitae addiction.

cruacRites.name: Feeding the Crone
cruacRites.summary: Offers blood to empower the Crone's rite.

thebanMiracles.name: Blood Scourge
thebanMiracles.summary: Creates a temporary whip of Vitae.

thebanMiracles.name: Vitae Reliquary
thebanMiracles.summary: Stores Vitae within a sacramental object.

thebanMiracles.name: Blandishment of Sin
thebanMiracles.summary: Reveals or confronts a subject's sin.

thebanMiracles.name: Curse of Babel
thebanMiracles.summary: Confounds a victim's ability to communicate.

thebanMiracles.name: Liar's Plague
thebanMiracles.summary: Punishes falsehood with a supernatural affliction.

thebanMiracles.name: Malediction of Despair
thebanMiracles.summary: Afflicts a subject with crushing despair.

thebanMiracles.name: Gift of Lazarus
thebanMiracles.summary: Calls on the Curse to restore the fallen.

thebanMiracles.name: Stigmata
thebanMiracles.summary: Marks a subject with miraculous wounds.

thebanMiracles.name: Transubstantiation
thebanMiracles.summary: Performs a supreme transformation of sacramental blood.

coils.name: Coil of the Ascendant
coils.summary: Transcends daysleep, fire, and sunlight through five cumulative tiers.

levels.name: Surmounting the Daysleep
levels.summary: While using Blush of Life, resist neither daysleep nor the Lethargic Condition for daytime activity.

levels.name: The Warm Face
levels.summary: Blush of Life lasts 24 hours instead of one scene.

levels.name: Conquer the Red Fear
levels.summary: Fire and sunlight no longer provoke frenzy.

levels.name: Peace with the Flame
levels.summary: While using Blush of Life, fire causes lethal damage; Resilience can reduce it further to bashing.

levels.name: Sun's Forgotten Kiss
levels.summary: Additional Vitae spent on Blush of Life lowers effective Blood Potency for sunlight intervals.

coils.name: Coil of the Wyrm
coils.summary: Refines and commands the Beast through five cumulative tiers.

levels.name: Stir the Beast
levels.summary: Spend Willpower to enter a voluntary frenzy directed toward a brief objective.

levels.name: Beast's Hunger
levels.summary: During frenzy, Coil rating increases effective Blood Potency for Kindred senses and predatory aura.

levels.name: Leash the Beast
levels.summary: Riding the Wave no longer costs Willpower and gains the Coil rating as a bonus.

levels.name: Beast's Power
levels.summary: Forgo frenzy resistance to add Blood Potency to Defense, Health, and Speed during frenzy.

levels.name: Eternal Frenzy
levels.summary: Frenzy can stave off torpor from lethal wounds and continue across scenes.

coils.name: Coil of the Voivode
coils.summary: Transforms blood bonds, loyalty, and the Embrace through five cumulative tiers.

levels.name: Taste of Fealty
levels.summary: The Dragon's Vitae counts double for addiction and becomes uniquely satisfying to those addicted.

levels.name: Into the Fold
levels.summary: Blood-bound subjects share closer blood sympathy with the Dragon.

levels.name: Call to Serve
levels.summary: Extra Vitae can accelerate a new blood bond directly to stage two or three.

levels.name: Voivode Undisputed
levels.summary: Blood sympathy cannot empower Disciplines against the Dragon and instead aids resistance.

levels.name: The Vast Dynasty
levels.summary: The Embrace no longer causes automatic Humanity loss and becomes a Humanity 3 breaking point.

scales.name: Day-Wake Conditioning
scales.summary: Reverses a vampire subject's sleep cycle under continuing conditions.

scales.name: Epidermal Shielding Bath
scales.summary: Temporarily raises effective Humanity against sunlight damage.

scales.name: Flesh Graft Treatment
scales.summary: Allows grievous wounds to be healed as lesser damage.

scales.name: Augmented Vitae Draught
scales.summary: Bottles a physical Vitae augmentation for a mortal subject.

scales.name: Kindred Sense Endowment
scales.summary: Temporarily grants a mortal vampire-like blood senses.

scales.name: Surgical Heart Removal
scales.summary: Removes a Kindred subject's heart through a dangerous procedure.

scales.name: Blood Cleansing Ritual
scales.summary: Attempts to remove an existing blood bond.

scales.name: Fealty's Reward
scales.summary: Creates an unusually enduring ghoul from a fully bound mortal.

scales.name: Mass Embrace
scales.summary: Embraces a prepared group through a dangerous collective procedure.

scales.name: Sanguinary Invigoration
scales.summary: Makes a living vessel temporarily suitable for vampires of much higher Blood Potency.
